title: sfn_delta silently treats booleans as protocol counters
description: python/src/lichen/timing/sfn.py documents sfn_delta(curr, last) as unsigned 32-bit counter arithmetic but performs no exact-integer validation. Because bool is an int subclass, sfn_delta(True, False) silently returns 1 and can turn malformed decoded state into a valid-looking SFN delta, while sibling slot_for already rejects booleans and non-integers explicitly. Require exact integers for both operands (continuing to normalize arbitrary integer values modulo 2^32 if that is the intended counter contract) and add bool/float/string/None edge tests.
